# Axis convoy capacity

Used in [Ports and shipping](/rules/logistics/50-ports-and-shipping).

- **Round up to:** 1000

## Table

| Level | Fixed tons | Tons per pip |
|---|---|---|
| A | 6000 | 1000 |
| B | 7000 | 1500 |
| C | 10000 | 1500 |
| D | 11000 | 2000 |
| E | 11000 | 2500 |
| F | 15000 | 2000 |
| G | 32000 | 3000 |

## Notes

- Axis Naval Convoy Capacity Table (SPI 56.5), jp2 178. Tonnage for the Game-Turn = fixed tons + tons_per_pip x one die, rounded up to the nearest 1,000 tons (with whole-die rolls every result is already a multiple of 500; only B and C at odd rolls round). 56.21 calls the same table the Tonnage Capacity / Tonnage Determination Table
- Cross-check: transcribed from the archive.org scan (jp2 178) and cross-checked cell by cell against the 300 dpi community scan (scan:discord:Axis Charts.pdf:p36): 0 of 14 cells differ. 56.21's worked example (level E, roll 4 = 21,000 tons) also agrees
